nodes.question: What are potential impacts of land use changes on radon emissions?
nodes.answer: Land use changes driven by climate adaptation strategies can disturb the soil and potentially increase radon emissions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land use planning|Climate-smart land use strategies_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What were the aims of this study regarding the socio-ecological system (SES) in the YRB?
nodes.answer: The aims of the study were to construct a network among SES components in the YRB, explore the effects of land-use and climate change on SES network coupling relationships, and identify their thresholds to guide ecological zoning management.
